title: Creature combat template
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/creatures/<id>.json. Loaded by presets.loadCreatureTemplateRaw. Storage: folder entity. Not the genre art roster (assets/data).

customSpriteGenre.description: Optional catalog genre for Custom Sprite when different from the mode genre (e.g. steampunk while editing a standard-mode creature). Empty = mode genre. Controls the catalog list and runtime sprite path for customSprite.

customSprite.description: Optional genre creature catalog id used for art when this template has no matching sprite under its own id. Designer: Select opens the creature catalog filtered by customSpriteGenre (or mode genre). Alpha thumb preview.

displayScale.description: Species visual size relative to a standard humanoid (1 = one tile tall at default draw settings). Rarity/affix mults from Settings.entitySpriteScaleByAffix multiply this (e.g. displayScale 1.5 × elite 1.6). Missing → 1.

level.description: Threat rank 1..1000 from log(threatDps) catalog map (npm run map:levels). Not an input to monster offense.

threatDps.description: Derived cache: sustained expected kit DPS on a naked single-target dummy (npm run measure:threat -- --apply). Not an input to monster offense; source of truth remains attacks[].

burstDps.description: Derived cache: expected opening DPS over the measure burst window (default 2s, all CDs ready at t=0). Not combat input.

avgHit.description: Derived cache: rate-weighted mean of (min+max)/2 across damaging attacks. Not combat input.

maxHit.description: Derived cache: highest attack.max on the kit (peak single-roll ceiling). Not combat input.

critChance.description: Kit crit chance percent (dump flags.critChance). Omit = 0. Not pipeline units.

critDamage.description: Kit crit extra percent (multiply after the kit roll). Six mapped dump rows author 10. Omit = 0.

isNpc.description: Talkable NPC (scenario / tutorial / vendor-lite). Not a hunt target unless attackableNpc.

attackableNpc.description: Escape hatch: attackable and never talk (Q6.2).

dialogId.description: Relation: kind=dialogs (presets_ids). Soft ref to presets/<mode>/dialogs/<id>.json. Author the tree on the dialogs kind; this is the live pointer.

walkInterval.description: C.4 wander period in ms. 0 / omitted = no wander. Requires speed > 0 and walkRadius > 0.

walkRadius.description: C.4 Chebyshev tiles from homeTile. 0 = cannot walk.

voices.description: C.4 idle voice lines. Alias voiceVector. Ticks only with a nearby spectator.

voiceInterval.description: C.4 voice roll period in ms. 0 / omitted = no voices. Alias yellSpeedTicks.

voiceChance.description: C.4 percent chance (1–100) to speak when voiceInterval elapses. Alias yellChance.

shop.description: Vendor-lite shop (C.3). Currency-as-item; buy/sell vs backpack. shop.when and row.when are re-checked at open and at click (not hide-only). No bank.

currency.description: Backpack item id used as money (default gold_coin). Designer: Select opens the equipment catalog.

when.description: Gate opening the shop (and every buy/sell). Same predicate as reply when.

denyText.description: FCT when shop.when fails. Default: I do not trade with you.

item.description: Item id (alias of itemId). Designer: Select opens the equipment catalog.

itemId.description: Item id (alias of item). Designer: Select opens the equipment catalog.

buy.description: Price the player pays per unit. 0 / omitted = not sold.

sell.description: Price the NPC pays per unit. 0 / omitted = not bought.

when.description: Hide this row unless the predicate matches. Re-checked at buy/sell.

dialog.description: Deprecated. Use dialogId + presets/<mode>/dialogs/<id>.json. Resolver still accepts an inline tree (tests / one-offs); if both are set, inline wins and the dialogs file is ignored.

set.description: Storage keys written when the player lands on this node (Phase C.1).

action.description: goto | close | custom | give_item | take_item | open_shop | trade. open_shop / trade open the vendor-lite shop (C.3).

command.description: Optional CUSTOM_COMMAND payload when action is custom.

item.description: Item id for give_item / take_item (alias of itemId).

give.description: NPC → player item spec ({ itemId|id|item, count }) on any reply. Re-checked at takeReply.

take.description: Player → NPC item spec ({ itemId|id|item, count }) on any reply. Re-checked at takeReply. All-or-nothing.

when.description: Hide this reply unless the predicate matches. Object or AND-array of { storage|key, eq?, neq?, min?, max? } or { item|itemId, eq?, neq?, min?, max? }. Storage unset = 0. Item counts the backpack tree. Re-checked at click / takeReply.

set.description: Storage keys written when this reply is taken (after when re-check and a successful give/take).

manaCost.description: Legacy convince/summon mana cost (0 = not usable that way).

strategiesTarget.description: Weighted target pick: nearest, health, damage, random. damage uses damageTakenBy with optional half-life decay (flags.threatDecayHalflifeSec). Mid-combat re-roll uses changeTarget only.

bestiary.description: Bestiary metadata (class, toKill, firstUnlock, secondUnlock, charmsPoints, stars, occurrence). Locations are not stored.

summon.description: Creatures this template can auto-summon in combat (runtime when features.monsterSummons; names mapped to standard ids).

id.description: Combat creature template id to summon. Designer: Select opens the creature catalog.

kind.description: Defense spell kind. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

attacks.description: Creature offensive kit. Each damaging row needs fixed min/max (or statusOnly). This is the only monster damage source; level is threat rank only.

id.description: Unique attack key (e.g. melee_0, area_1, fire_wave).

element.description: Damage or drain element for resistance calculations.

range.description: Maximum tile range. Live on melee / wave / status too — do not hide by kind (Save would drop it).

radius.description: Radial size. Live on area plus some ranged / status / melee field kits — do not hide by kind.

length.description: Wave / beam length in tiles. Also present on some status rows.

spread.description: Wave cone spread width. 0 is a live value.

target.description: Whether attack requires an explicit targeted entity.

statusOnly.description: True if attack only applies status condition without direct hit damage.

effect.description: Magic / impact visual effect animation. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

shootEffect.description: Distance / missile visual effect animation. Live on melee too. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

condition.description: On-hit status applied via applyCondition (kernel/core/lib/combat/conditions.js). Stored form is engine-canonical only — never CONDITION_* / freezing. Legacy dumps are converted at port time (legacy_monster_port.convertCondition). DoT: type + totalDamage + intervalMs. Speed: type slow|haste + speedChange + durationSec. Invisible: type + durationSec.

type.description: DoT kind (poison→earth, fire, ice, energy, bleed→physical, curse→death, holy) or slow / haste / invisible. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

totalDamage.description: Total DoT damage over the condition lifetime (decaying ticks).

speedChange.description: Absolute speed delta applied to baseSpeed (slow negative, haste positive).

source.description: How the template was authored (pipeline = monster port). Metadata only.

race.description: Creature race / blood type (pipeline). Used by some immunities and flavor. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

maxBlock.description: Shield-block ceiling (0 = none). Copied onto the instance at spawn.

loot.description: Corpse drop table. chance is a 0–100000-scale weight (some pipeline rows exceed 100000). id is an equipment catalog row; name-only rows are unresolved leftovers.

id.description: Equipment catalog id. Designer: Select opens the equipment catalog.

name.description: Display / pipeline name. Prefer id when the catalog has a matching row.

chance.description: Drop weight (pipeline 0–100000 scale; higher values exist).

minCount.description: Minimum stack when the row drops. 0 is used on some pipeline rows.

maxCount.description: Maximum stack when the row drops.

count.description: Fixed stack when min/max are omitted.

unique.description: When true, at most one of this row drops.

changeTarget.description: Per-creature retarget. interval (ms) + chance (%) override AI_CREATURE_RETARGET_INTERVAL. interval 0 or chance 0 = sticky.

interval.description: Retarget roll period in milliseconds. Runtime converts to seconds. 0 = never periodic retarget.

chance.description: Percent chance to pick a new target when the interval elapses. 0 = stay sticky. Interval always re-arms even on a failed roll.

immunities.description: Status immunities from the pipeline. Object of booleans is the authored form; empty array means none. immunities.invisible also sets canSeeInvisibility at spawn.

flags.description: Kit movement/aggro flags. NPC identity: isNpc / talkable (same meaning as top-level); hostile / attackableNpc never talk (Q6.2).

targetDistance.description: Preferred stand-off in tiles (1 = melee). 0 / omitted = runtime melee hug. Do not hide — Save would invent 1 on every flags object.

runHealth.description: Flee when current HP is at or below this absolute value (0 = never).

runHealthPercent.description: Flee when current HP fraction is at or below this (0–1).

staticAttackChance.description: Percent chance to stand and attack instead of stepping.

aggroRange.description: Tiles at which the creature acquires a target.

loseTargetDistance.description: Tiles at which the creature drops its target.

idleWander.description: Combat idle wander. Do not use for talkable NPC walk (docs/31).

threatDecayHalflifeSec.description: damageTakenBy half-life in seconds (0 = no decay).

isNpc.description: Talkable NPC identity (same meaning as top-level isNpc).

attackableNpc.description: Escape hatch: attackable and never talk (Q6.2).
